spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    $__timeGroup("time", '5m') AS "time",
    AVG("value") AS "",
    "deviceName" as "metric"
FROM "temperature"
WHERE
    $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1, "deviceName"
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
    $__timeGroup("time", '1m') AS "time",
    AVG("value") AS "",
    "deviceName" as "metric"
FROM "power"
WHERE
    $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1, "deviceName"
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
    $__timeGroup("time", '5m') AS "time",
    "deviceName" as "metric",
    AVG("value") AS "%RH"
FROM "humidity"
WHERE
    $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1, "deviceName"
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
    date_bin(INTERVAL '1 hour', "time", TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') AS "time",
    round(AVG("value") / 1000.0, 3) AS "kWh"
FROM "power"
WHERE
    $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

spec.description: Average draw of the server rack outlet per hour, converted to kWh (avg watts / 1000). ~0.25 kWh/h => ~6 kWh/day at the current ~250W baseline.
spec.title: Rack Energy per Hour (kWh)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    round(SUM(w) * (5.0 / 60.0) / 1000.0, 2) AS "kWh"
FROM (
    SELECT AVG("value") AS w
    FROM "power"
    WHERE
        $__timeFilter("time")
    GROUP BY date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', "time", TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
)

spec.description: Total energy consumed by the rack outlet over the dashboard time range. With a 24h range this should read ~6 kWh; thresholds are per-day (7 / 10 kWh).
spec.title: Energy (selected range)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', "time", TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') AS "time",
    round(AVG("value"), 1) AS "Rack °F"
FROM "temperature"
WHERE
    "deviceName" = 'Server Rack Temp Probe'
    AND $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
    date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', "time", TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') AS "time",
    round(AVG("value"), 0) AS "Rack W"
FROM "power"
WHERE
    $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

spec.description: Rack intake temperature (left axis) against rack watts (right axis). Thermals that climb while watts stay flat mean cooling trouble, not load.
spec.title: Rack Temperature vs Power Draw

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    'temperature' AS metric, "deviceName", MAX("time") AS last_seen,
    round(extract(epoch from now() - MAX("time")) / 60.0) AS minutes_ago, COUNT(*) AS samples
FROM "temperature" GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'humidity', "deviceName", MAX("time"),
    round(extract(epoch from now() - MAX("time")) / 60.0), COUNT(*)
FROM "humidity" GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'battery', "deviceName", MAX("time"),
    round(extract(epoch from now() - MAX("time")) / 60.0), COUNT(*)
FROM "battery" GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'power', "deviceName", MAX("time"),
    round(extract(epoch from now() - MAX("time")) / 60.0), COUNT(*)
FROM "power" GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY minutes_ago DESC

spec.description: Rows are devices per measurement. Probes report every ~5 min, so anything over 15 min is a dead sensor or a hub that stopped forwarding - the case the temperature chart hides by simply not drawing.
spec.title: Sensor Freshness (minutes since last sample)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    round(CAST("upTime" AS BIGINT) / 86400.0, 1) AS "Hub uptime (days)",
    "mode" AS "Mode",
    "sunriseTime" AS "Sunrise",
    "sunsetTime" AS "Sunset",
    "firmwareVersion" AS "Firmware"
FROM "_hubInfo"
ORDER BY "time" DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.description: From _hubInfo. An uptime that resets without explanation means the hub rebooted; mode/sunrise/sunset explain ambient swings.
spec.title: Hub Status
